definitions.explanation: Areas outside of cities, with fewer people and more nature.
One's place of origin, especially if rural.
Can imply lack of urban sophistication.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk along a country road.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}かで→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Country life is nice and quiet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{田舎|いなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいて→住む：00673_sumu⟧、⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather lives in the countryside and grows vegetables in a large field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{田舎|いなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I go back to my hometown for summer vacation.

examples.english: We make it a point to go back to our hometown as a family for New Year's.

examples.japanese: {田舎|いなか}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦おいしかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: The vegetables sent from my hometown were fresh and very delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{田舎|いなか}⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧。
examples.english: That person is a bit provincial.
examples.notes: {田舎|いなか}⟦っぽい→っぽい：06781_ppoi⟧ = rustic, unsophisticated

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{田舎者|いなかもの}→田舎者：27627_inakamono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: When I first came to Tokyo, I was called a country bumpkin.
examples.notes: ⟦{田舎者|いなかもの}→田舎者：noentry⟧ = country person (can be derogatory)

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れる→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{田舎|いなか}⟦くさい→臭い：01133_kusai⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{恥|は}ずかしかった→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧。
examples.english: Until I got used to city life, I was embarrassed by my own rustic mannerisms.
examples.notes: {田舎|いなか}⟦くさい→臭い：01133_kusai⟧ = unsophisticated, hick-like

notes:
{田舎|いなか} means 'countryside' or 'rural area.'

Nuances:
- Can be neutral (rural area) or slightly negative (backward/unsophisticated)
- When referring to one's own hometown, it's neutral or affectionate
- Using it about someone else's hometown could be rude

Common expressions:
- {田舎|いなか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to return to one's hometown
- {田舎|いなか}⟦{暮|ぐ}らし→暮らし：02670_kurashi⟧: country living
- {田舎|いなか}⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: country person (can be derogatory)

Antonym: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧ (city, urban area)

Note: The kanji {田|た}{舎|や} (rice field + house) reflects the agricultural nature of rural Japan.
